visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a white floral bikini top, red bikini bottoms, and a wide-brimmed straw hat, walks forward in a sunlit covered corridor with a dark slatted ceiling. She smiles brightly and carries a black tote bag and a smartphone. (2) The scene cuts to a back view of the woman walking down a paved path in a luxury resort area. She is surrounded by tropical trees, palm fronds, and flowering bushes under a clear, bright blue sky. (3) She transitions to a swimming pool, stepping down the white stone stairs into the turquoise water. A small waterfall fountain and white patio umbrellas are visible in the background against green hedges. (4) The woman is shown waist-deep in the pool, looking at the camera with a cheerful expression. She then begins swimming breaststroke across the pool, with the camera tracking her from a side profile. (5) A high-angle overhead shot captures her floating peacefully on her back in the center of the pool, eyes closed and limbs relaxed. (6) She stands up in the water, raising both arms high in the air with a jubilant smile, celebrating the moment. (7) A final shot shows her from behind, standing in the water and looking toward the far end of the resort pool area.
